finding_candidates.statement: The h^0 range recorded for the C66-GEO-H0 stratification is not sharp, and one of its strata is empty. On every smooth genus-6 fibre of the balanced tetragonal CE family, M := omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee is ALWAYS special, because h^1(M) = h^0(omega tensor M^vee) = h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) >= 1. Hence whenever h^0(M) > 0, Clifford's theorem applies and gives h^0(M) <= deg(M)/2 + 1 = 3, with equality only if C is hyperelliptic and M ~= (g^1_2)^{tensor 2} (the cases M ~= O_C and M ~= omega_C are excluded by deg M = 4 not in {0,10}). Therefore h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) is in {1,2,3,4} and NEVER 5, so the {h^0(L)=5} = {h^0(M)=4} stratum is empty, and h^0(L)=4 occurs only on hyperelliptic fibres. The C66-GEO-H0 stratification has at most four strata, and its top jump stratum is confined to the hyperelliptic locus.

finding_candidates.statement: Modulo GAP-Z-W5D (i.e. granting M ~= O_C(D) = gamma^*O_{P^1}(1)), the constancy question left open as GAP-H0-1 collapses to a single geometric exclusion. Indeed h^0(D) >= 2 always (gamma^* is injective on H^0(P^1,O(1))), and by FC-CLIFFORD-H0-BOUND h^0(D) <= 3 with equality only if C is hyperelliptic and D ~ 2 g^1_2. In that equality case |D| = |2H| = h^*|O_{P^1}(2)| for the hyperelliptic map h, so every pencil inside |D| is h^* of a pencil in |O_{P^1}(2)|, i.e. gamma = q o h with q: P^1 -> P^1 of degree 2 - gamma is non-primitive. Hence h^0(omega_C(-D)) = 1 + h^0(D) is in {3,4}, and 'h^0(omega_C(-D)) = 3 constantly on the whole balanced locus' is EQUIVALENT to 'no balanced fibre carries a tetragonal pencil factoring through a degree-2 map'. The remaining checkable question is exactly whether a non-primitive degree-4 pencil can have balanced CE splitting F = O(4)+O(5); this review does not settle that and does not assert the answer.

finding_candidates.statement: GAP-Z-W5D is not a deep gap; it localizes to exactly one normalization statement, and the packet already contains the arithmetic that pins the remaining freedom. The packet's own CE line-bundle convention is W_5 := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C. Granting only the CE relative-canonical normalization in the weak form O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C ~= omega_{C/P^1} tensor gamma^*A = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2) tensor gamma^*A for SOME line bundle A on P^1, one gets W_5 ~= omega_C^2 tensor gamma^*O(-1) tensor gamma^*A^2 = omega_C^2(-D) tensor gamma^*A^2. The residual twist is then forced away by degree: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 records deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)|_C) = 2(2g-2+4*2), i.e. deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C) = 2g+6 = deg(omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2)), and a twist by gamma^*A shifts this by 4 deg A, so deg A = 0 and A ~= O_{P^1}. Hence W_5 ~= omega_C^2(-D), equivalently L ~= omega_C(-D) and M ~= O_C(D). Note the derivation needs balancedness only to make the labels f = (4,5) meaningful, not for the isomorphism itself. Consequence: the campaign should either add the CE relative-canonical normalization as a cited source line - one citation - or keep every downstream clause explicitly conditionalized on GAP-Z-W5D; what it should NOT do is what ATT-0057 does, namely relabel the gap as an established working-context fact.

finding_candidates.statement: Evidence for FND-0047 in a form the H0 and COMP nodes will keep hitting: restricting the pushforward is not the same as pushing forward the restricted family, and the two differ exactly at jump walls. For a locally closed stratum S subset B that is not open, (pi_*L)|_S and (pi_S)_*(L|_{C x_B S}) are different sheaves, and Grauert's theorem gives local freeness and base change only for the latter. Concretely, over a reduced irreducible B = A^1 with h^0(L_b) = 1 for b != 0 and h^0(L_0) = 2, pi_*L is locally free of rank 1, so (pi_*L)|_{S_2} with S_2 = {0} has rank 1, while h^0(C_0, L_0) = 2. Any statement of the shape 'pi_*L|_{S_r} is locally free of rank r on the constant-h^0 stratum S_r' is therefore false under the standard parse and must be written as (pi_{S_r})_*(L restricted to the family over S_r). Restricting to constant-h^0 strata is the right move for FND-0047, but it does not by itself fix the notation, and the error reappears precisely at the jump strata the campaign cares about.

theorem_statement: Theorem (h0-stratification of the residual degree-six system, C66-GEO-H0). Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and let gamma: C -> P^1_k be a smooth balanced tetragonal genus-six curve. Let 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 be the canonical filtered Casnati-Ekedahl reduction (FND-0097), with deg(W_5)=16 on the geometric fibre, and set L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}. Then: (i) deg(L)=6 and chi(L)=1, hence h^0(C,L)>=1. (ii) With M := omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, one has deg(M)=4 and h^0(C,L) = 1 + h^0(C,M). (iii) Consequently, in any family of such geometric fibres, the h^0(L)-stratification is the Brill-Noether stratification of the degree-4 bundle M shifted by one: {s : h^0(L_s)>=r} = {s : h^0(M_s)>=r-1} for all r>=1; moreover h^0(M)<=4, so h^0(L) is in {1,2,3,4,5} and dim |L_s| = h^0(L_s)-1; the P^2 stratum {h^0(L)>=3} is exactly the relative g^1_4 locus {h^0(M)>=2} of M. (iv) On the balanced locus with fibre divisor D, using the working-context established fibrewise identity W_5 ~= omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), one has M ~= O_C(D) = gamma^*O_{P^1}(1) and L ~= omega_C(-D); since gamma^* injects H^0(P^1,O(1)) into H^0(C,O_C(D)), h^0(M)>=2 and h^0(L)>=3 everywhere on the balanced locus, and the strata are exactly h^0(L)=3 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=2 (exact-pencil locus, |L| a net), h^0(L)=4 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=3, h^0(L)=5 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=4. (v) Over any framed family gamma: C -> P^1_B (so that O(1), hence W_5 and L, are globally defined) and any reduced locally closed stratum S_r on which h^0(L_s)=r is constant, pi_*L|_{S_r} is locally free of rank r with formation commuting with base change (Grauert), and the relative complete linear system over S_r is the projective bundle of lines in pi_*L|_{S_r} of relative dimension r-1; no Proj(pi_*L) identification is asserted across jump walls (FND-0047). Not claimed: constancy of h^0(M)=2 on the balanced locus, dimensions/codimensions/components/stabilizers of jump strata, and nonemptiness of reduced-support opens.
